name: M7.RawCoverage.root_within
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (S : Finset (ZMod N)), M7.PrefixOrbit.Within (M7.PrefixBits.A N []) (M7.PrefixBits.WA N []) S ↔ (0 : ZMod N) ∈ S
guidance: Use PrefixBits.root with positivity from NeZero.pos N. The root selected is {0} and remaining is range N minus {0}. encode=image val is always contained in range N. Zero in encode iff zero in S via ZMod.val_injective or val_eq_zero. Empty S and N=1 retained. Return tactic lines without leading by.
